The '''Anchorhead Spaceport''' was located in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-controlled [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
